import fs from 'node:fs/promises'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { chromium } from 'playwright'

const root = process.cwd()
const config = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile('runtime.json', 'utf8'))
const browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: '/usr/sbin/chromium', headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] })
const context = await browser.newContext({ ignoreHTTPSErrors: true })
const page = await context.newPage()
const checks = []
const errors = []
const requests = []
const externalFixtures = []
const fixturePng = await fs.readFile('fixture-input.png')
let phase = 'setup'
page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push({ phase, type: 'pageerror', message: error.message }))
page.on('console', message => { if (message.type() === 'error') errors.push({ phase, type: 'console', message: message.text() }) })
page.on('response', response => { if (response.url().startsWith(config.origin)) requests.push({ phase, method: response.request().method(), path: new URL(response.url()).pathname, status: response.status() }) })
await context.route('**/*', async route => {
  const req = route.request()
  if (req.url().startsWith(config.origin + '/')) return route.continue()
  externalFixtures.push({ type: req.resourceType(), origin: new URL(req.url()).origin })
  if (req.url().includes('exchangerate-api.com')) return route.fulfill({ contentType: 'application/json', body: JSON.stringify({ rates: { USD: 1, KES: 130 }, base: 'USD' }) })
  if (req.resourceType() === 'stylesheet') return route.fulfill({ contentType: 'text/css', body: '' })
  if (req.resourceType() === 'image') return route.fulfill({ contentType: 'image/png', body: fixturePng })
  throw new Error(`Unexpected external request ${req.resourceType()}`)
})
async function checkImage(locator, variant, name) {
  await locator.waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
  await locator.evaluate(image => image.decode())
  const state = await locator.evaluate(image => ({ current: image.currentSrc, src: image.getAttribute('src'), width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight, complete: image.complete }))
  assert.ok(state.current.startsWith(config.mediaBase + '/images/v1/'), `${name}: owned URL`)
  assert.ok(state.current.endsWith(`/${variant}.webp`), `${name}: ${state.current}`)
  assert.equal(state.complete, true)
  assert.ok(state.width > 0 && state.height > 0)
  checks.push({ phase, name, variant, naturalWidth: state.width, naturalHeight: state.height })
}
try {
  for (const width of [390, 1440]) {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 950 })
    phase = `home-${width}`
    await page.goto(config.origin, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await checkImage(page.getByRole('img', { name: 'R2 fixture home', exact: true }), 'card', 'featured property')
    await checkImage(page.getByRole('img', { name: 'R2 fixture article', exact: true }), 'card', 'latest blog')
    phase = `listings-${width}`
    await page.goto(config.origin + '/listings', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await checkImage(page.getByRole('img', { name: 'R2 fixture home', exact: true }), 'card', 'listing card')
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'View Details: R2 fixture home', exact: true }).click()
    await page.waitForURL(`**/listings/${config.propertyId}`)
    await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Description', exact: true }).waitFor()
    phase = `details-${width}`
    await checkImage(page.getByRole('img', { name: 'R2 fixture home', exact: true }), width < 768 ? 'card' : 'large', 'property hero')
    await checkImage(page.getByRole('img', { name: 'R2 fixture home 2', exact: true }), 'thumbnail', 'gallery thumbnail')
    await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0))
    await page.screenshot({ path: `property-${width}.png`, fullPage: false })
    phase = `blog-${width}`
    await page.goto(config.origin + '/blog', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await checkImage(page.getByRole('img', { name: 'R2 fixture article', exact: true }), 'card', 'blog card')
    await page.goto(config.origin + '/blog/' + config.postId, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
    await checkImage(page.getByRole('img', { name: 'R2 fixture article', exact: true }), 'large', 'blog hero')
  }
  phase = 'admin-edit-upload'
  const bootstrap = await page.evaluate(async () => { const result = await fetch('/fixture/bootstrap').then(r => r.json()); localStorage.setItem('token', result.token); return true })
  assert.equal(bootstrap, true)
  await page.goto(config.origin + '/admin/properties', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
  await checkImage(page.getByRole('img', { name: 'R2 fixture home', exact: true }), 'thumbnail', 'admin table')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit', exact: true }).click()
  await checkImage(page.getByRole('img', { name: 'Property 1', exact: true }), 'thumbnail', 'existing edit preview')
  await page.locator('#edit-property-images').setInputFiles(root + '/fixture-input.png')
  await page.getByRole('img', { name: 'Preview', exact: true }).waitFor()
  assert.match(await page.getByRole('img', { name: 'Preview', exact: true }).getAttribute('src'), /^(blob:|data:)/)
  checks.push({ phase, name: 'local preview unchanged' })
  const uploadResponse = page.waitForResponse(response => response.url().endsWith('/api/upload') && response.request().method() === 'POST')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save Changes', exact: true }).click()
  assert.equal((await uploadResponse).status(), 200)
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Edit Property', exact: true }).waitFor({ state: 'hidden' })
  await page.reload({ waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit', exact: true }).click()
  await checkImage(page.getByRole('img', { name: 'Property 3', exact: true }), 'thumbnail', 'new upload after fixture save/reload')
  const state = await page.evaluate(async () => fetch('/fixture/events').then(r => r.json()))
  assert.equal(state.images.length, 3)
  assert.ok(state.images.every(url => url.endsWith('/large.webp')))
  assert.equal(state.objectCount, 9)
  assert.equal(state.events.filter(event => event.method === 'POST' && event.path === '/api/upload' && event.status === 200).length, 1)
  assert.equal(requests.some(request => request.status >= 400), false)
  assert.deepEqual(errors, [])
  checks.push({ phase, name: 'canonical strings preserved through fixture PUT/reload; actual upload codecs/S3-double', objectCount: state.objectCount })
  await fs.writeFile('browser-result.json', JSON.stringify({ passed: true, checks, requests, externalFixtures, errors, fixtures: ['catalogue/blog CRUD and auth profile are in-memory API fixtures; owner model is a method double', 'upload route, owner middleware, Sharp and React production bundle are real; S3 send is an in-memory object double', 'currency/fonts/remote stock images intercepted; no real provider/database access'] }, null, 2))
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ passed: true, imageChecks: checks.length, responses: requests.length, errors: errors.length }))
} catch (error) {
  await page.screenshot({ path: 'browser-failure.png', fullPage: false }).catch(() => {})
  await fs.writeFile('browser-failure.json', JSON.stringify({ passed: false, phase, error: error.message, checks, requests, errors }, null, 2))
  throw error
} finally {
  await context.close()
  await browser.close()
}
